images.prompt: Editorial interior photograph of the lamp room at the very top of a Victorian lighthouse, converted into a single hotel bedroom. A huge antique brass-and-glass Fresnel lens stands beside a low double bed made with crisp white linen and a heavy undyed wool blanket. Curved floor-to-ceiling glass walls with dark cast-iron glazing bars on every side, beyond them a dark stormy North Atlantic at blue hour with whitecaps and low racing cloud. Rain beads on the outside of the glass. The lens throws warm sodium-yellow prisms of light across the white sheets and the curved iron. Moody, quiet, luxurious, Kinfolk / Cereal magazine style, 35mm film photograph, natural grain, no people, no text, no watermark.

Editorial interior photograph of a lighthouse keeper's quarters in a whitewashed granite cottage, converted into a hotel room. Thick walls with a deep-set small sash window showing a grey heaving sea. A black cast-iron stove glows with a peat fire, a narrow scrubbed oak table holds a brass oil lamp and an open handwritten logbook, a worn leather armchair with a folded tartan wool blanket, painted tongue-and-groove panelling in pale grey-blue, a single low bed with white linen tucked in tight. Warm lamplight against cold blue window light, deep shadows. Kinfolk / Cereal magazine style, 35mm film photograph, natural grain, no people, no text, no watermark.

Editorial interior photograph of an old fog signal house on a sea rock converted into a hotel room. Rough dark granite walls, the enormous flared mouth of a brass foghorn trumpet mounted through the wall, polished and green with age. A freestanding copper bathtub full of steaming water stands under a small arched window looking straight down at white surf smashing on black rocks. Slate floor, a thick sheepskin rug, a wrought-iron candle stand. Cold grey daylight from the window, warm candle glow, steam in the air. Kinfolk / Cereal magazine style, 35mm film photograph, natural grain, no people, no text, no watermark.

Editorial interior photograph of the circular watch room of a lighthouse, just below the lantern, converted into a hotel room at dawn. A curved window seat with linen cushions runs along a band of small round-topped windows, a brass telescope on a wooden tripod points out to a calm pale sea, old nautical charts are pinned to the curved whitewashed wall, a narrow iron spiral stair rises through the ceiling, a daybed with a grey wool throw. Soft pink and apricot dawn light pours in low through the windows. Serene, luxurious, Kinfolk / Cereal magazine style, 35mm film photograph, natural grain, no people, no text, no watermark.
